**Steven Crijns** is a Belgian automotive designer who was one of the six designers who participated in the [Hot Wheels Designers Challenge](/wiki/Designers_Challenge); he represented [Lotus Cars](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lotus_Cars), for he was Lead Designer of Lotus, by designing the [Lotus Concept](/wiki/Lotus_Concept) for said series. He first joined Lotus in 1994 and left in 2014 to move to McLaren, where he has remained since. He has worked on the [765LT](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/McLaren_720S), [Speedtail](/wiki/McLaren_Speedtail) and "[a next-generation](/wiki/McLaren_W1) [P1](/wiki/McLaren_P1)".
